content: Browse API item_summary/search endpoint (GET /buy/browse/v1/item_summary/search): requires at least one of q, category_ids, epid, gtin, or charity_ids. Supports fieldgroups (ASPECT_REFINEMENTS, BUYING_OPTION_REFINEMENTS, CATEGORY_REFINEMENTS, CONDITION_REFINEMENTS, EXTENDED, MATCHING_ITEMS), filter (price:[min..max], priceCurrency, conditions, maxDeliveryCost for free-shipping-only, buyingOptions), sort, limit, offset, aspect_filter. Example: ?q=drone&category_ids=179697&limit=3&fieldgroups=EXTENDED,MATCHING_ITEMS. Price range filter example: ?q=drone&filter=price:[300..800],priceCurrency:USD,conditions:{NEW}. Category IDs 183050, 183454, 261328 relate to Collectible Card Games / graded cards categories on eBay; exact category ID for Pokemon sealed product not confirmed - recommend keyword search (q) as primary filter with optional category_ids narrowing, verified empirically in Phase 1.
